title: Andy LaVerne's writing and Chuck Mangione as a potential writer
summary: Wong asks about a former band writer; Herman plans to ask Chuck Mangione to write for the band.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Incidentally, just thinking about that, have you heard Andy Eddie LaVerne's latest music that he's been doing the last couple of years, since he's been writing for -- For Getz?
Oh. He's really very fertile, I think.
Yeah, that's right, I think he would -- this is off the record, completely, but (unintelligible) people that, if he went back to school now he could really help himself.
Yeah, he's been learning a lot, apparently. And Ed got tremendous assistance from the experience in your band, no question about it. He talked about it.

Well, I'll tell you, my next -- I have no idea whether it could come to pass or not, but I'm going to make some sort of attempt to get Chuck to write something for the band. It doesn't have to be a serious piece, it could be anything he wants to write.
Because I feel he's developed an audience that should hear it played the way we would do it.
And he seems to be a -- I haven't gone into it serious with him, but I will.
That's a good idea. Very good.
